snippet.title: 🚀 TANKS: 1985 – Official Trailer 🚀
snippet.description:
The classic arcade tank battles return with a modern twist!
Reimagined from the legendary Battle City, TANKS: 1985 combines retro 8-bit charm with new features, competitive multiplayer, and endless replay ability.

🎮 Key Features

⚔️ Classic tank battles with modern polish
🛡️ Defend your base from endless waves of enemies
🌍 Multiplayer action with friends & global players
🏆 Leaderboards, achievements, and rewards
🗺️ Map editor + player-to-player shop for trading custom maps
🎶 Retro-inspired soundtrack for pure arcade vibes

💾 Project files & assets for this video are available on my Patreon:
👉 https://www.patreon.com/posts/complete-2d-game-140106044?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_creator&utm_content=join_link

📅 Coming soon to Steam – Add it to your Wishlist today!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4042460/Tanks_1985/

💬 Stay connected & join the community:
🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/S2TvGHa9
🐦 Twitter: https://x.com/CODEHUBh

🔥 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe to support indie game development!
Your Wishlist helps bring the game to life.
